title: Create @archmap/lifecycle plugin
description: Create the lifecycle workspace package and installer that registers the MVP schema, relation vocabulary, validators, and view definitions as one plugin.
completion_criteria: Define Requirement, AcceptanceCriterion, Decision, Risk, Test, Evidence, LifecycleRelation, statuses, and vocabularies in the lifecycle package.
installLifecycle() and plugin default export register schema, relation types, validators, and views in one operation.
Support isolated createArchMap().use(lifecycle) and a backward-compatible default-instance convenience installer.
Package builds independently and declares a compatible @archmap/core peer range.
success_criteria: Plugin installation is idempotent and conflict-safe.
Browser ESM/CDN and Node ESM installation paths have focused tests.
